text:
Nina: Heads-up — the scorecard 'Flagged samples' drilldown is showing a lot of empty previews. clicking rows yields blank pane :thinking:
Sam: seeing that too. Filter counts look OK but preview payload is null.
Alex: repro'ed. suspecting the runner change that landed yesterday. @Sam did we change sample serde?
Sam: yeah small change: runner now stores payloads as base64 gzipped json for space. UI was parsing plain json before :grimacing:
Nina: ah that would do it. UI didn't decode/ungzip. any quick fix?
Harper: short term we can surface id + link to rehydrate via /api/samples/:id, but proper fix is parsing on frontend
Alex: I'll add decoding in the client. patch incoming — might be a small util in samplePreview.ts
Sam: also opened a PR to make runner flag the storage format in metadata so clients can handle variants — PR 2547
ci-bot: CI pipeline: eval-runner-integration #2547 failed at unpack step: sample_mapper.java: NullPointer on line 213
Nina: thanks @ci-bot. @Alex can you add a defensive fallback so empty preview shows "compressed payload, click to rehydrate" instead of blank?
Alex: yep. implementing fallback + notice banner. will include tests for both plain/json and gz64 formats.
Harper: can we add an alert rule in console: when >5% of drilldown rows have empty preview => slack notification to #eng-ml ?
Sam: agree. also adding a telemetry tag for storage_format so we can chart regressions over releases
Nina: perfect. prioritize client patch and a follow-up to update docs for sample storage. thanks all :thumbsup:
